The '''Squirrel Figurine''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]]. It can be obtained by [[Fishing#Presents|fishing]] in the northernmost section of the river on [[Ginger Island]]. 

The required river section to the northwest of the [[Ginger Island#Dig Site|Dig Site]] can be accessed by entering the [[Volcano Dungeon]] and using the [[Watering Cans|Watering Can]] to create a path through the lava river to the secondary exit on the far left side. The first time fishing there has a 100% chance of obtaining the figurine (90% if the [[Ginger Island#Dig Site|Dig Site]] bridge is repaired). Afterwards, each cast gives a 10% chance to obtain another figurine (9% if the Dig Site bridge is repaired).<ref name="squirrelchance" />
